design_rationale:
WORKLOG / TEST DOSSIER — warranty_rework_desk task 0 (Calibration Workmanship Warranty: goodwill on a mileage-excluded calibration fault).

[Step 0 — draw] `draw_counts.py <diff> --task 0` printed {"task": 0, "prerequisite_problems": 1, "problems": 2, "factor_counts": [5, 6]}. Design fitted to it: one prerequisite problem; the calibration diagnostic charge (warranty_ext_calibration_diagnostic_charge) takes 5 factors, the calibration goodwill (warranty_ext_calibration_goodwill) takes 6. `--tasks 2` showed task 1 draws 3 prerequisite problems with factor counts [5, 6, 4, 5].

[Scope snapshot] Occupied before this task: nothing (first task). Claimed here: warranty_ext_calibration_diagnostic_charge (target accept_calibration_diagnostic_charge_d9578b72, owner=user) and warranty_ext_calibration_goodwill (target grant_calibration_goodwill_f9a2e5bf, owner=agent). Reserved headroom for task 1 (4 problems, 3 prerequisites): the parts side of the desk on a collision coverage — electrical and mechanical diagnostic charges, the same-visit courtesy reduction and the network rework authorization with courtesy rental days — four distinct policies and tools that this task does not touch, so task 1 keeps an independent root and tree. Every write event of the desk with a computable amount is split by business subtype (calibration vs parts charges; discretionary calibration goodwill vs the automatic same-visit courtesy), so the two tasks never reuse a policy core.

[Why this is a good test] The customer asks one natural question — can anything be done about the inspection fee. The scored numbers are a calibration diagnostic charge and a goodwill amount the customer never names. To answer, the agent must (1) read out of the goodwill rule that goodwill is figured only after the charge owed on the not-covered finding stands on the account, (2) see in the money history that no charge is booked, (3) work out from the charge rule that the charge for a not-covered calibration fault is the write that brings that state about, and hand it to the customer to accept, (4) compute a five-factor charge from the source calibration order, the customer's alignment and attempt history and the coverage's rework history, and (5) compute a six-factor goodwill from the exclusion, mileage and time in service, glass and calibration payments, covered findings and report timing. Difficulty is policy reading, reconciliation and arithmetic; there is one charge tool and one goodwill tool for calibration coverages, so tool choice is not the test.

[Problem-tree card] root = warranty_ext_calibration_goodwill (on_request). Edge warranty_ext_calibration_goodwill -> warranty_ext_calibration_diagnostic_charge: kind value_input, gate charge_amount, form state. Prerequisite sentence (policy_source, verbatim in the goodwill rule): "Calibration goodwill is figured only after the calibration diagnostic charge owed on the not-covered calibration finding stands on the coverage's account." Four-point test: ordering connective 'only after'; the waited-on side is a record-visible state (a charge standing on the coverage's account); no tool, id or code token; exact scope (the charge owed on the not-covered calibration finding). Exactly one write of this difficulty brings that state about for a calibration fault: the calibration diagnostic charge acceptance (accept_calibration_diagnostic_charge_d9578b72); the electrical and mechanical charge tools book charges only for parts findings on collision or structural coverages. Derivation: sentence + records (inspection 6775c004-09bd-4a59-bf0e-dc1af79e0689 not_covered, ledger empty) + the charge rule ('posts one calibration diagnostic charge for that concern') -> the one resolving action is the calibration charge acceptance, owner user. Seed evidence it is false at the opening: initial_state.warranty_ledger is empty; warranty_events.6775c004-09bd-4a59-bf0e-dc1af79e0689.determination = not_covered. Topological order: warranty_ext_calibration_diagnostic_charge then warranty_ext_calibration_goodwill. Deletion sensitivity (verification run): skipping step 12 gives goodwill 16.20 instead of 33.47 and leaves no charge row. Owner=user problem: the charge acceptance — the customer accepts a fee booked to her own account, in person, on the spot; nothing waits on a real-world event. user_scenario names neither the prerequisite nor any order; tools validate no prerequisite (both tool bodies only ctx.create a ledger row).

[Base-invariant card] Charge (warranty_charge): governing base policy warranty_evt_diagnostic_fee; no eligibility gate applies to warranty_charge (charge_open applies to payment and waiver), so policy_scope; its amount clause 'An inspection that finds a concern not covered posts a diagnostic charge of diagnostic_fee_usd only when the concern type is in the plan's diagnostic_fee_concern_types; every other inspection is free, covered or not.' is superseded for calibration findings by the extended charge rule (declared in overwrite), whose replacement sentence restates that every other inspection stays free; the fee-bearing scope is unchanged (calibration_fault is in the Calibration plan's fee types). Goodwill (warranty_charge_waiver): governing base policy warranty_evt_diagnostic_fee, gate charge_open ('A charge that is already paid or waived in full takes no further payment or waiver.') — authority system_record, correlation warranty_ledger.source_entry_id -> action arg source_entry_id; satisfied by the charge booked at step 12 (open, nothing paid or waived). The goodwill never exceeds the plan's goodwill authority 40.00 (base cap kept; overwrite []). No time gate applies to either write.

[Business-object card] Target object: concern 2 on Calibration Workmanship Warranty 4a031888-d2b8-4d5b-8fdb-9f7189af5dcf (source order 1f4b3712-60a0-4d53-97b7-9ba56c09cc53). Correlation key: (warranty_coverage_id, concern_number=2) for the charge; source_entry_id wle_d82a063864d9 for the goodwill. Excluded: concern 1 (covered, no charge); coverage b9ff9fc6-3ef1-447f-b629-7ab129f94e3e (expired, other order); glass coverage 23578632-223a-4e16-a9e6-0d436a8032f8 (glass installation only); the insurer-free glass job charges are read only as loyalty evidence. No existing waiver, payment or reimbursement settles anything on 4a031888-d2b8-4d5b-8fdb-9f7189af5dcf.

[Factor card — calibration diagnostic charge, 5 factors] baseline: 'The calibration diagnostic charge is the plan's standard diagnostic fee, charged in full once for the concern, in US dollars rounded to the cent.' -> 79.95 (all-baseline result).
 1 calibration_procedure_fee (parameter, cross-difficulty adas): ladder static_and_dynamic -> 109.95 / dynamic -> 94.95 / otherwise standard fee. Evidence adas_orders.1f4b3712-60a0-4d53-97b7-9ba56c09cc53.oem_procedure = static_and_dynamic. Baseline figure 128.90.
 2 calibration_alignment_fee (parameter, adas): two or more out-of-spec alignment checks on the customer's calibration orders -> the source tier's alignment check fee (59.95) / exactly one -> alignment verification fee 29.95 / none -> 0. Out-of-spec checks on file = 1: adas_events.b9eecbc7-71e3-4549-a184-7ae9722b0eaf (2026-01-20, order 1f4b3712-60a0-4d53-97b7-9ba56c09cc53, corrected the same visit). Near-miss: the in-spec re-checks 757098bf-a393-4e4b-9a66-aeca46cc4dae (2026-01-20) and f7975157-892f-48b8-ac11-1a259061514a (2026-01-22) and daa77808-5477-4bf3-8bee-759dd50b8e0d (2026-07-16, the latest check on file) and c6be4102-bc1f-4ad4-94fb-0cd17f5d4410 (2025-05-12, in spec) do not count, and the January check having been corrected does not remove it from the count; a reader keyed on the latest check (in spec) would charge no alignment fee. Baseline figure 113.95.
 3 calibration_sensor_scan_fee (parameter, adas): multiple_systems -> 39.95 / a radar alone -> 24.95 / camera alone -> 0. Source order systems multiple_systems; near-miss: the 2025 order dc942de0-7b8f-4e09-9a58-c11d569c5804 is forward_camera but is not the source order. Baseline 103.95.
 4 calibration_history_fee (parameter, adas): >=2 failed attempts -> 40.00 / exactly 1 -> 20.00 / none -> 0. One failed attempt a51dee1c-c9b4-4274-b8d2-84294f0cc526 (dynamic, drive_time_exceeded); the same order's attempt 2 passed and does not cancel it. Baseline 123.90.
 5 calibration_recheck_rate (method, history): a remedy attempt (network rework or outside-shop repair) completed resolved < 3 whole months -> procedure fee halved and rounded down to the dollar / < 12 months -> times 0.75 rounded to the cent / otherwise in full. Rework dffeed8f-45c1-4136-9fcd-b01070e1ca54 resolved 2026-07-21, MONTHS to 2026-10-13 = 2. Baseline 199.85.
 result 54 + 29.95 + 39.95 + 20.00 = 143.90.
[Factor card — calibration goodwill, 6 factors] baseline: 'The calibration goodwill is the standard goodwill share of the calibration diagnostic charges booked on the coverage less than one whole calendar month before, limited to the plan's goodwill authority per charge and rounded to the cent.' -> 143.90 x 0.05 = 7.195 -> 7.20 (all-baseline result).
 1 calibration_goodwill_share (parameter): mileage/term exceeded -> 0.10 / not a covered kind -> 0.07 / otherwise 0.05; exclusion mileage_exceeded. Baseline 24.83.
 2 calibration_low_use_allowance (parameter, multi-source: miles AND months): (<=14,000 mi and <12 months) -> 6.00 / (14,001-16,000 and <12) -> 3.00 / otherwise 0. 44,980 - 31,240 = 13,740 miles, 8 months. Baseline 26.27.
 3 calibration_glass_loyalty_allowance (parameter, glass ledger): >=2 customer glass payments in 36 months -> 4.00 / 1 -> 2.00 / 0 -> 0. One payment c5671fe4-c3e3-4dfb-a617-d357e830adb1. Baseline 31.07.
 4 calibration_order_loyalty_allowance (parameter, cross-difficulty adas ledger): >=2 customer calibration payments in 24 months -> 4.00 / 1 -> 2.00 / 0. Payments 20f1189f-9803-4a0f-8b01-b5b9b142560d and 966ec5a1-039a-40db-b7f7-1c29d57820be (payer_kind customer); near-miss none other. Baseline 28.67.
 5 calibration_prior_trouble_allowance (parameter): >=2 covered inspections -> 3.00 / 1 -> 1.50 / 0. One covered inspection 2b1ec6fe-e297-4b73-a592-a827b2dc3fb4; the not-covered 6775c004-09bd-4a59-bf0e-dc1af79e0689 does not count. Baseline 31.67.
 6 calibration_report_timing (method): report <=3 days after discovery -> sum x1.5 rounded up to the dollar / 4-10 days -> sum x1.2 rounded to the cent / later -> as figured. 2026-10-02 -> 2026-10-06 = 4 days. Baseline 27.89.
 sum 14.39 + 6 + 2 + 4 + 1.5 = 27.89 -> x1.2 = 33.468 -> 33.47 (< authority 40.00).
Every factor's tier rests on seeded rows; no stamp field is read. Cross-category reads (adas order fields, adas events and ledger, glass ledger) are read-only; neither policy writes another category.

[World rows] customers C0 (identity); vehicles e112d288-21c9-45b9-9729-0de3339f2d02 (owned_through empty: still owned); glass_jobs 27860ae2-483c-4102-a322-2c9e78a9bfc0 + glass_ledger charge/payment (glass loyalty); adas_orders dc942de0-7b8f-4e09-9a58-c11d569c5804/1f4b3712-60a0-4d53-97b7-9ba56c09cc53/ec22bf5a-4314-4f41-b26a-5c4bb084efa9, adas_events (5 alignment checks — 2025-05-12 in spec; 2026-01-20 out of spec and corrected, re-checked in spec the same day, and re-checked in spec again on 2026-01-22 before the dynamic retry as the Multi-System tier's retry rule requires; 2026-07-16 in spec — and 6 attempt rows), adas_ledger (charges posted on each completion date as the adas charge rule sets them — 2025 order: 349.00 calibration + 59.95 alignment check, paid 408.95; January order: 895.00 calibration + 179.85 for three alignment checks + 129.95 correction, paid 1,204.80; the July warranty-rework order posts no charge — and two customer payments) — every one feeds a factor or is the near-miss; warranty_coverages 4a031888-d2b8-4d5b-8fdb-9f7189af5dcf/b9ff9fc6-3ef1-447f-b629-7ab129f94e3e/23578632-223a-4e16-a9e6-0d436a8032f8 (coverage choice); warranty_events concern 1 history (covered, reworked, resolved: prior-trouble and re-check evidence) and concern 2 (report + not-covered inspection: the obligation). Removing the July rework completion flips the re-check tier (charge 199.85); removing the customer card payment on 1f4b3712-60a0-4d53-97b7-9ba56c09cc53 drops the calibration loyalty tier (goodwill 31.07). Automatic clauses checked: the Calibration plan term runs to 2027-01-22 (no expiry due); the 2025 coverage is already expired; no void or sale; no charge is owed on concern 1 (covered); no other policy is lit.

[Persona] Marisol Vance, brisk home-health nurse. Volunteered: the surface request (anything about the inspection fee) and the context the inspector told her (not covered because of miles, there would be a diagnostic fee) — both are in the records (inspection 6775c004-09bd-4a59-bf0e-dc1af79e0689). Given only when asked: name, phone 7205550537, PIN 5318, email, ZIP, vehicle, discovery and report dates. Passive: agrees to the charge being booked, accepts it with the values the agent gives once handed the step, thanks and ends on hearing the reduction. She never knows the fee amount, never mentions booking or accepting a charge on her own, never asks to pay.

[Standard solution] find_customers -> verify (phone + PIN) -> vehicles -> coverages -> warranty events -> warranty ledger (no charge: prerequisite unmet) -> glass jobs and glass ledger -> adas orders, events, ledger -> unlock + customer calls accept_calibration_diagnostic_charge_d9578b72(coverage 4a031888-d2b8-4d5b-8fdb-9f7189af5dcf, concern 2, 143.90) -> unlock + grant_calibration_goodwill_f9a2e5bf(coverage 4a031888-d2b8-4d5b-8fdb-9f7189af5dcf, source wle_d82a063864d9, 33.47).

[Verification code] A throwaway authoring script (kept outside env/ and deleted after authoring; check_compute.py reproduces every figure below from the published charter) replayed the gold writes with the real tools and evaluates check_compute.build_env/eval_compute at each step's handling time. Output: charge step 12 -> 143.9 (factor baselines 128.9 / 113.95 / 103.95 / 123.9 / 199.85; all baseline 79.95); goodwill step 14 -> 33.47 (baselines 24.83 / 26.27 / 31.07 / 28.67 / 31.67 / 27.89; all baseline 7.2). Prerequisite skip run: without step 12 the goodwill is 16.20.

[Revisions — round 2, policy audit] T0-1 (alignment tier rested on adas rows the adas charter forbids): symptom — the latest alignment check on two completed Multi-System orders was an out-of-spec check, which the adas precheck rule rules out; root cause — the seeded adas history skipped the in-spec re-check after a correction, the re-check before the dynamic retry, and posted charges off the completion date; change — seeded the charter-required re-checks (2026-01-20 check 2, 2026-01-22 check 3, July check in spec), moved every adas charge to its completion date with the alignment-check charge (179.85 for three checks) and the 1,204.80 payment, made the glass job complete on 2026-01-22 (calibration_before_release) with its charge, payment and Glass Installation Lifetime issue on that date, and re-founded the alignment factor on the count of out-of-spec checks on file instead of the latest check; re-run: charge 143.90 and goodwill 33.47 unchanged, alignment baseline 113.95 unchanged. F-1 (charter): rules now say 'remedy attempts ..., network reworks and outside-shop repairs alike', matching compute (every completion row); no value moves on this coverage. O-3/O-5a/O-11 closed in the charter (rework gate compute branch; the goodwill edge condition no longer carries the one-month window; replacement sentences restate that every other inspection stays free). T0-O2: the alignment factor is no longer labelled multi-source (the task's multi-source factor is calibration_low_use_allowance). [Revisions — round 1] (1) First world used an insurance claim repair for repair loyalty; replay_tasks reported closure mismatch (insurer profile and repair order unread) -> root cause: the loyalty evidence dragged in parents no read feeds -> changed the factor to glass-job payments and made the windshield customer-pay; goodwill re-ran 31.07 -> 33.47; policy, compute_basis, factor names, tracing propagated. (2) Empty foreign keys were seeded as empty strings -> dangling-FK failure -> seeded as null. (3) Charge tools now write an explicit empty source reference so the charge row carries the gate field the waiver's charge_open evidence binds.

[Draft recomputation from the visible context] Reading only the published rules, tool schemas, the finder returns and the persona: the goodwill rule sends the agent to the charge; the money history shows none; the charge rule gives 109.95 -> 54 (re-check) + 29.95 + 39.95 + 20.00 = 143.90; goodwill 0.10 x 143.90 + 6 + 2 + 4 + 1.5 = 27.89, report lag 4 days -> 33.47. Same objects, same order, same values as gold.
user_scenario: You are Marisol Vance, a home-health nurse in Aurora, Colorado, who spends her days driving between patients in her 2023 Toyota RAV4. You are calling Crestline's warranty desk on a short break between visits, so you are friendly but brisk and talk in short, practical sentences. Early this month the RAV4's driver-assist camera started throwing a warning and switching lane-keeping off; Crestline inspected it last week and the inspector told you the camera problem is not covered under your calibration warranty because of how many miles you have driven since the windshield and calibration were done in January, and that there would be a diagnostic fee for the inspection. You understand the miles are on you, but the fee stings, and you'd like to know whether anything can be done about that inspection fee. That is the only thing you are calling about; you are not asking for a repair or a recalibration today. You do not know how the desk works out fees or reductions, and you did not catch the amount of the fee, so if anyone asks you say the inspector only mentioned that there would be a diagnostic charge. When the agent asks who you are, you give your full name, Marisol Vance, and the phone number on your account, 7205550537; if a second detail is needed you give your account PIN, 5318. You only give your email (marisol.vance@fastmail.com) or your ZIP code (80016) if the agent asks for one of those specifically. If asked which vehicle, it is your 2023 Toyota RAV4, the one whose windshield Crestline replaced and whose cameras they calibrated in January. If asked when you first noticed the warning, it was October 2nd, and you reported it on October 6th. If asked how far you drive, you say your job puts a lot of miles on the car. If the agent explains that the inspection charge has to be on your account first and asks whether you agree to it, you say yes, go ahead. When the agent hands you the step to accept the charge, you accept it exactly as the agent describes it, with the coverage, the concern and the amount the agent gives you, without asking for a breakdown; you assume they know their own pricing. Once the agent tells you how much of the fee they can take off and that the reduction has been applied, you thank them, say that helps a lot, and end the call. If the agent tells you nothing can be taken off, you accept that politely and end the call. You do not offer to pay anything today and you do not ask for anything else.
